action_items: Fix demo@beatcut.fr subscription seed: current_period_end is in the past → user is now FREE, contradicts /app/memory/test_credentials.md and the review request ('/dashboard affiche l'abonnement BASIC du demo'). Either seed with rolling +30d period or set subscription.plan='basic' with never-expiring current_period_end for the demo account.

critical_code_review_comments: landing.html iframe onLoad handler correctly patches a[href^='/'] target=_top so landing CTAs escape the iframe — verified working. All /login CTAs have target=_top.
POST /api/telemetry/webview is public (no auth) as required; anti-abuse relies on 500-char UA truncation + 50-char build truncation which is fine. Admin GET properly gated by require_admin(user).
studio.html (v3) is 3867 lines but is a delivered founder file — not to be modified per review request.

Landing.js uses BUST=Date.now() at module scope: guarantees cache-bust once per page-load, good. However every dashboard→landing navigation reloads the iframe with a fresh timestamp — acceptable but slightly wasteful; could use build-hash env var instead.

Demo user subscription is stored as raw object without plan field — /api/subscription line 217 computes tier from active flag: this design silently degrades expired subs to 'free' which is correct behavior, so the bug is in the SEED, not the endpoint.

rca of the issue: Demo BASIC-plan regression: seed_user() only creates the user record; subscription block was seeded once (started_at=2026-07-22, current_period_end=2026-07-24) and is now expired because pod clock advanced to 2026-07-27. get_subscription() at server.py:217 correctly returns tier='free' when subscription is not active. Fix: in startup seed, if demo user exists, refresh subscription.current_period_end to now_utc()+30d and set subscription.plan='basic'.
